technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish but short-term momentum severely depressed with no confirmation of reversal; oversold conditions lack rising RSI/MACD support and price remains below key moving averages.

fundamental.summary: ED shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings volatility in 6 days—fundamentals lack conviction across all smart money indicators.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent score 20) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and stale trading data (484+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (443.36) combined with critical earnings event in 6 days creates severe binary risk; flat yield curve and rising dollar add structural headwinds for utilities sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA structure (50/200 bullish) + Ichimoku above cloud + extreme fear sentiment (contrarian buy signal) + price near support (82.51) create textbook capitulation setup for reversal.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings event in 6 days + VIX crisis regime (443.36) + zero momentum confirmation (RSI oversold without rising, MACD negative, no crossovers) + price below EMA-9/20 + no smart money accumulation = binary risk event with depressed short-term technicals and no institutional conviction.
